title: Cantwell Arrestor Cruiser
text: When Played: You may disclose VigilanceVigilanceVillainy (reveal cards from your hand with these aspect icons among them). If you do, exhaust an enemy unit. That unit can't ready while this unit is in play.
rules:
Until Cantwell Arrestor Cruiser leaves play, the chosen unit can't ready. This effect is not changed if an opponent takes control of Cantwell Arrestor Cruiser.
If Cantwell Arrestor Cruiser is captured and then rescued, its "When Played" effect does not resume.
